ID: `jado-run`.

## What it does

Locates the JADO folder and verifies the method index. For questions about capabilities or next steps, consults ask-jado and returns guidance; for execution, opens jado-flow, reusing decisions and assignments already received. Method changes go through source files, checks and a PR.

## When to use it

Use it as the entry point when requesting work from JADO without remembering the coordination procedure. jado-flow handles execution; ask-jado answers guidance requests and clarifies missing decisions during work.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-run` in Claude Code or `$jado-run` in Codex. Specify the JADO folder when working in another repository and describe the outcome, materials and boundaries, optionally with the stage, involvement and budget dials. Request the activity or plan. If a contract already exists, pass it along so the agent resumes from the assigned point.

## What it delivers

- Located method and coordinated route
- Requested outcome or plan
- Any proposed method change for review

## Example

Use jado-run, with this JADO folder, to review the new invitation flow read-only and return issues, evidence and priorities.

## Prerequisites

- Requires access to jado/runtime/index.json and the selected route packet in the specified JADO folder.
